elements.element: Customer pays no liquidated damages or penalties.
elements.evidence: Section 3.4(b) is retained: Customer's convenience termination remains conditioned on "paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments." The inserted sentence caps that charge rather than eliminating it, so a Customer-payable liquidated amount survives. To reach preferred, 3.4(b) itself would have to be deleted (with conforming fixes to the 3.4 lead-in and the 3.3 cross-reference).

elements.element: Any Customer-payable liquidated amount is only an early-termination fee.
elements.evidence: Inserted: early termination charges under Subsection 3.4(b) "are the only liquidated amount payable by Customer under this Agreement; Customer will pay no other liquidated damages or penalties." No other Customer-payable liquidated or penalty mechanic is retained in the cited operative text.

elements.element: The early-termination fee is capped at three months of fees.
elements.evidence: Inserted: "Early termination charges under this Subsection 3.4(b) will not exceed three (3) months' charges for the terminated Services" — an express numeric ceiling at three months of charges (fees) that overrides any larger amount set in Attachment A or a Service Option Attachment; the cap is not exceeded (it is measured on the terminated Services only).

elements.element: The early-termination fee is the sole liquidated amount payable by Customer.
elements.evidence: Inserted: the charges "are the only liquidated amount payable by Customer under this Agreement," stated unconditionally and applying Agreement-wide, not just to Attachment A.

reasons: Fallback is position-complete: one inserted sentence supplies the three-month cap, the exclusivity of the early-termination charge as the only liquidated amount, and the absence of any other liquidated damages or penalties. Nothing is left to the margin comment and no trigger is undefined.

Preferred remains unmet solely because Section 3.4(b)'s payment condition is retained; the drafter would need to strike "paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments" and repair the 3.4 lead-in and the Section 3.3 cross-reference to Section 3.4(b) to achieve it.

Minimality holds: a single concise insertion, no deletions, no survival tail, no expense or procedure language, and no favourable existing language removed. The clause "Customer will pay no other liquidated damages or penalties" is a mild restatement of the exclusivity element but is co-extensive with elements 1 and 3 rather than an added obligation outside the checklist; the cap is set exactly at the three-month threshold and is not exceeded.

Intent is preserved: the Section 3.3 protection that IBM "shall not be entitled to recover the early termination charges described in Section 3.4(b)" where IBM has breached still operates unchanged, the Attachment A / Service Option Attachment cross-references remain intact (now merely subject to a ceiling), and the convenience-termination mechanics and month-end timing are untouched. No dangling term or contradictory retained sentence is created.
